video_title: Mike James Tried to Fight Us… Then Invited Us to Bible Study 😂 | Tallest Tales Explained

quotes.speaker: Brendan Haywood
quotes.summary_phrase: The false media narrative regarding Gilbert Arenas's locker room guns
quotes.excerpt: The original story that was leaked to the media was not true at all.
quotes.quote: The original story that was leaked to the media was not true at all. There was some story that was leaked that Gilbert was storing his guns in the locker room in some safe or something. It was a total fabrication, and then within a day the media had the real story of Gilbert, Javaris, Crittenton, the guns in the locker room, the standoff, and all that stuff.

quotes.speaker: Brendan Haywood
quotes.summary_phrase: The locker room reaction to the Mike James snitching rumors
quotes.excerpt: Everybody in the locker room is talking about it, but no one's talking to Mike James about it.

text_blocks.speaker: Brendan Haywood
text_blocks.text: Everybody in the locker room is talking about it, but no one's talking to Mike James about it. And then all of a sudden Caron Butler says, 'Hey Mike, you just tell them the truth. A lot of guys in here think you snitching.'

quotes.speaker: Brendan Haywood
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike James's explosive reaction to being called a snitch
quotes.excerpt: Mike James just runs up in front of the locker room, takes his shirt off, throws it down.
quotes.quote: Mike James just runs up in front of the locker room, takes his shirt off, throws it down in the middle of the locker room and is like, 'Yo, anybody thinks I'm snitching can come fight me right now.' You got to understand, they're having their own separate conversation. It's not in front of the locker room. Mike just got triggered. Caron told him that everybody thought that he was snitching, and I guess he could sense that he heard, he saw the whispers early on in practice.

quotes.speaker: Brendan Haywood
quotes.summary_phrase: DeShawn Stevenson's intervention during the Mike James locker room incident
quotes.excerpt: DeShawn Stevenson was like, 'Yo, listen here man, who are you talking to?'

text_blocks.speaker: Brendan Haywood
text_blocks.text: DeShawn Stevenson was like, 'Yo, listen here man, who are you talking to?' DeShawn asked him who he was talking to. Mike said, 'I told you I'm talking to everybody.' DeShawn was like, 'You ain't talking to DeShawn Stevenson.' Now you know anybody that starts talking in the third person is ready for the smoke. So now, because this got left out, now Mike and DeShawn about to get into it.

text_blocks.speaker: Daylon A. Goff
text_blocks.text: So it went from every single person, one, switched to the other, to the other.
